summary: For one woman interviewed for the 2019 social assessment of Karachi’s planned Yellow Line Bus Rapid Transit (BRT), getting to her job destination meant walking 20 minutes to a road crossing, paying for a rickshaw and then paying again for a bus. Other women interviewed for the assessment relied on shared three-wheelers that waited to fill up with passengers before leaving. For some, the journey could take two hours each way. Monthly transport costs ranged from Rs3,000 to Rs6,000 in households where incomes of Rs20,000 to Rs30,000 were common. Fares can eat into an already modest wage.
